versions.changelog:
v1.0.1 patch — clarify scope of '≤2 parallel sub-agents' rule.
- Iron rule 3 now explicitly: ≤2 for shared-state research (same files); ≤4 acceptable for independent investigations
- Cross-reference trinity-harness for general-purpose concurrency limits

Initial release. Decision-focused build protocol for high-stakes choices (investments, major purchases, technology selection, supplier choice). Adds: real-time data verification mandate, methodology transparency (PE/DCF/MA), position-sizing discipline, stop-loss as first-class rule, daily P/L tracking. Guards against 'Sycophancy of Precision'.
